heroHeadline: ENDF and Allied Militia Claim Alamata as Tigray Blackout Enters Fourth Day
heroSubtitle: Federal forces claim to have retaken Alamata in southern Tigray after the EPFAS coalition's Sep 23 offensive; Reuters could not verify, and telecom disruption across Tigray is limiting independent reporting.
